title: Ecclesiastes – Everything is Vanity Under the Sun
description: Ecclesiastes, David's son and king in Jerusalem, reflects that everything under the sun is vanity and a chasing after wind. He describes that all things have their time appointed by God, and concludes with the exhortation to remember your Creator in your youth, fear God and keep his commandments, for God will judge every deed.

versions.title: Ecclesiastes – Everything is Transient
versions.description: Ecclesiastes reflects on the transience of life and concludes that everything under the sun is vanity, but that people should fear God and keep his commandments.
